test_cases.name: minimal_api_single_field
evaluation_criteria: Generated test should only assert on fields defined in the API spec (id, name)
Should not assert on fields not in the schema like description, price, category

rule_based_criteria.description: Should not reference 'description' field not in schema
Should not reference 'price' field not in schema
Should not reference 'category' field not in schema

test_cases.name: no_request_body_api
evaluation_criteria: Should not create a request body/payload for a GET endpoint that has no requestBody
Should focus on query parameters and response validation only

rule_based_criteria.description: Should not use POST/PUT/PATCH methods for a GET endpoint

test_cases.name: limited_methods_service
evaluation_criteria: Should only use methods defined in RecordService (getRecords)
Should not call non-existent methods like createRecord, deleteRecord, updateRecord in setup/teardown

rule_based_criteria.description: Should not call non-existent createRecord method
Should not call non-existent deleteRecord method
Should not call non-existent updateRecord method

test_cases.name: exact_schema_properties
evaluation_criteria: Should only assert on fields defined in the schema: id, title, author
Should not fabricate additional fields like isbn, publisher, year, pages, genre

rule_based_criteria.description: Should not assert on fabricated 'isbn' field
Should not assert on fabricated 'publisher' field
Should not assert on fabricated 'pages' field
Should not assert on fabricated 'genre' field

test_cases.name: enum_constrained_values
evaluation_criteria: Should only use defined enum values for status field: 'active', 'inactive', 'pending'
Should not use undefined status values like 'completed', 'cancelled', 'deleted', 'archived'

rule_based_criteria.description: Should not use undefined enum value 'completed'
Should not use undefined enum value 'cancelled'
Should not use undefined enum value 'deleted'
Should not use undefined enum value 'archived'

test_cases.name: no_auth_in_spec
evaluation_criteria: Should not generate authentication/authorization setup code when spec has no security schemes
Should not include bearer token, API key, or basic auth setup

rule_based_criteria.description: Should not include Bearer token setup
Should not include Authorization header setup
Should not include API key setup

test_cases.name: readonly_fields_not_in_request
evaluation_criteria: Should not include readOnly fields (id, createdAt, updatedAt) in the request payload
ReadOnly fields should only appear in response assertions, not in the request body sent to the API

rule_based_criteria.description: Should not include 'id' field in request payload object

test_cases.name: only_documented_status_codes
evaluation_criteria: Should only assert on documented response status code (201)
Should not assert on undocumented status codes like 200, 400, 404, 500 in the main test

rule_based_criteria.description: Should assert on the documented 201 status code
